title: ISO 8573-3:1999 — Compressed air — Part 3: Test methods for measurement of humidity
locator: Official abstract: selection of humidity measurement methods, sampling, measurement, evaluation, uncertainty and reporting; excludes measurement of water in states other than vapour.
notes: Humidity measurement method does not measure liquid condensate or all other water states. Do not equate a dew-point reading with absence of liquid water in downstream pipework.
